prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1133; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording right now, but you can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Houston, Texas, heading to a left turn onto a side street. It was a busy stretch with a lot of traffic coming the other way.

Q: What happened as you started your turn?

A: I had a green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic. When I started to turn, a car came through from the opposite direction and hit the front passenger side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not clearly. I think it was coming fast, but I was focused on the oncoming lanes and didn't check the far side of the intersection the way I should have.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My right knee hit the dashboard and twisted under me. I've had trouble putting weight on it since, and the doctor said I may need an MRI and possibly physical therapy.

Q: Have you been seen by a physician since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and then saw my regular doctor a few days later. I still have swelling and pain when I climb stairs.

Q: Did you make any statements at the scene?

A: I told the other driver I was sorry, but I didn't say I was at fault. I was just shaken up.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to make sure my knee gets properly treated. I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
